task.title: Deleting an organization by using the UI
task.shortdesc: To permanently delete an organization in Quay, you can use the v2 UI.

step.cmd: On the Organizations page, select the name of the organization you want to delete, for example, testorg.
Click the More Actions drop down menu.

note.p: On the Delete page, there is a Search input box. With this box, users can search for specific organizations to ensure that they are properly scheduled for deletion. For example, if a user is deleting 10 organizations and they want to ensure that a specific organization was deleted, they can use the Search input box to confirm said organization is marked for deletion.

step.cmd: Confirm that you want to permanently delete the organization by typing confirm in the box.

info.p: After deletion, you are returned to the Organizations page.

note.p: You can delete more than one organization at a time by selecting multiple organizations, and then clicking More Actions → Delete.
